SELECT o.id as offerId, d.id AS offerDetailId, o.offer_no AS offerNo, o.customer_id AS customerId, o.customer_name AS customerName, o.salesman_id AS salesmanId, o.salesman_name AS salesmanName, d.product_id AS productId, d.product_code AS productCode, d.product_name AS productName, d.product_spec AS productSpec, d.custom_product_code AS customProductCode, d.custom_product_name AS customProductName, d.custom_product_spec AS customProductSpec, d.unit AS unit, d.package_id AS packageId, d.package_code AS packageCode, d.package_name AS packageName, d.package_spec AS packageSpec, d.package_capacity as packageCapacity, d.package_capacity_unit as packageCapacityUnit, d.price_type AS priceType, d.qty_min AS qtyMin, d.qty_max AS qtyMax, d.effective_date AS effectiveDate, d.expiry_date AS expiryDate, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.tax_rate AS taxRate, d.min_order_qty AS minOrderQty, d.qty_step AS qtyStep, d.status AS status FROM mis_price_offer_detail d INNER JOIN mis_price_offer o ON d.offer_id = o.id WHERE o.approve_status = '1' AND o.status = '1' AND o.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '1' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.effective_date <= CURDATE() AND (d.expiry_date IS NULL OR d.expiry_date >= CURDATE())
AND o.customer_id = #{priceOfferDetailVo.customerId}
AND o.salesman_id = #{priceOfferDetailVo.salesmanId}
AND d.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{priceOfferDetailVo.productCode}, '%')
AND d.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{priceOfferDetailVo.productName}, '%')
AND d.custom_product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{priceOfferDetailVo.customProductName}, '%')
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
